findings.title: Untested forwarding hops for allow_inline_credentials
findings.problem: allow_inline_credentials is forwarded through seven hops. Three have no assertion: _collect_server_results -> _process_single_server_for_tools (line 310), _process_single_server_for_tools -> _process_single_mcp_server (line 350), _process_single_mcp_server -> _prepare_server_config (line 805). The new tests stop at the next hop or call the resolver directly; no test runs get_mcp_server_tools through to the resulting server env. The parameter defaults to False, so an omission fails silently.
findings.impact: The flag chain was read end to end and is correct today. If a hop later drops or misspells the kwarg, the EPMCDME-11766 fix reverts without any test failing: MCP test and tool-fetch with unsaved credential_values fall back to the by-id lookup with settings.id=None and the server starts without env.
findings.recommendation: Add tests that patch the next hop and assert call_args.kwargs['allow_inline_credentials'] is True for each of the three untested hops (model on test_process_single_mcp_server_passes_execution_context_to_prepare_server_config in tests/codemie/service/mcp/test_toolkit_service_auth_resolver.py:352), or one test running get_mcp_server_tools with inline settings and asserting the resulting env.
